kapak.alt: Datalogging and hearing aid use in children

youtube.baslik: Do parents accurately estimate how long their child wears hearing aids? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In one study, parents reported their children used hearing aids about 11 hours a day on average, while datalogging for the same children showed about 8 hours. In the OCHL study, 10 or more hours of daily use went with faster language growth, so datalogging is reviewed together with the family.
